review.verdict: Useful match-feedback concept, but fails gameplay fidelity after the triple clears: the final tile arrangement differs materially from the observed original.
review.method: Compared nine extracted frames with the combined first frame, source-checked plan and captured original first-triple outcome; no continuous playback or listening.
review.first_frame_layout: Complete first-frame layout closely follows the combined reference: four columns, original highlighted birds, HUD, tutorial and full disclosure footer.
review.triple_selection: Hand visits the correct bottom-left bird, then the two birds in columns 2 and 3 one row above. All three clear together around 4.5s; tutorial hand/text disappear. Selection happens slightly earlier than the planned beats.
review.board_state: Incorrect after the drop. At 10–11.5s, bottom-left is green發 instead of the required red flower. Numerous other surviving positions differ; the untouched fourth column also changes. The upper area introduces altered dot-color patterns. This is not the prescribed six-row result or a faithful column-only fall.
review.counters_and_cta: At 10–11.5s, Level 1, Winnings $21.00 and Match 1 are correctly readable, with a green centered Play Now button above the unchanged footer. A new gold star remains beside Match, absent from the reference outcome.
review.vfx_readability: The three bright green clearance flashes correspond to the correct three cells. The flashes briefly hide those selected tiles but clear; they do not obstruct the footer or HUD. Empty gaps linger at 6s before the incorrect rearrangement.
review.camera_and_ui_continuity: No major HUD or camera drift is visible in the sampled frames: HUD position, frame and footer stay stable. A stray desktop arrow cursor appears below the hand around 2s. The added Match star is a UI addition.

audio.note: AAC presence verified only; voiceover, sound effects and synchronization were not listened to.

recommended_adjustments: Keep every surviving tile identity and column order; use the captured six-row final board exactly, including the unchanged fourth column.
Remove the stray desktop cursor and unsupported persistent Match star.
review.limitations: Representative frame review establishes visible mismatches, not a frame-by-frame temporal or audio validation. No retry or paid call was made.
